plan.archetype: Efficient attacks into flexible poison and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Build reliable damage before steam escalates. Preserve health and a defensive potion or strong block hand for the post-kill explosion.
plan.summary: Prioritize efficient damage, then sustained poison and stronger defense. Remove Strikes after replacing their damage. Take elites with adequate health, potions, and recovery access; upgrade useful damage early and heal before the boss when needed.
